market_question: Will Eleni Kounalakis win the California Governor Election in 2026?
reasoning: Eleni Kounalakis is the sitting Lieutenant Governor of California and a major Democratic candidate for the 2026 open-seat gubernatorial race. Given the overwhelming Democratic advantage in statewide elections, the winner of the Democratic primary is almost certain to become governor. Current polling and her institutional position give her a 15% chance—far above the 0.2% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Kounalakis has announced her candidacy, possesses strong name recognition, and has a formidable fundraising network as a Newsom ally.
A UC Berkeley IGS poll in August 2024 showed her support at 8% in a crowded field, with a clear path to remain competitive.
California has voted Democratic in every gubernatorial election since 2006; the general election is not a significant hurdle for the Democratic nominee.
sources_consulted: Ballotpedia – California gubernatorial election, 2026 candidate list
